summary: Your third teach-back. You write what you know, explain why a test set is kept hidden in 5 sentences or a voice note, check six key points, and run an experiment on random labels where the best of 200 models looks good by luck.
goal: Explain in 5 sentences why a test set is kept hidden, and show it with an experiment.

items.text: Write one line each for train, validation and test set, plus one thing you are unsure about
Explain why a test set is kept hidden in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note, without notes
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Run peek.py and see 0.66 on the test set but 0.54 on fresh data
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap and compare with your earlier teach-backs
Play the Peek Detector game to the end and see your score
